Our understanding of the literature is that there is no such thing as safe use of volatile hydrocarbon gases: their psychoactive effects are inseparable from nerve and organ damage.]
I bought a can on engine started fluid from an auto parts store. Hearing about ehter, and getting some nitrous soon I decided to try this to be able to compare. I sprayed about 1/2 a cup of the liquid in a gatorado bottle, pourse some water in and then drained of the bottom layer. Then I poured it onto a rag and went into my room. I sat down with my back against the door and put the rag to my face. With the first two inhalations I got a very big head rush, and starting seeing black with glowing stars. I inhaled from the rag about 2 or 3 more times, and the next thing I know, the whole world is rotating. I am being pushed through my door into my hallway, and I can see where my sock got stuck under the door between my room and my hallway from when I went thru the door. Then I close my eyes and open them and I am staring at tile, and I wonder where I am. And I look up and I am in a bathroom with doors on both sides an old nightmare of mine, and both doors are locked. It all feels real, and then I freak out because if its real tehn I am stuck in here forever. I finally unlock one of the doors and walk out and I'm in my hallway. Thats when I realized I had passed out and dreamt of being sucked thru the walls and being trapped in a bathroom. It was all very realistic and it was very cool. I was still very confused but it was pretty amazing. I will probably do it again soon.
